description: ADR-022 Amendment A. One sentence names two employers with two periods. The expectation is two SEPARATE employment facts, one employer and one period each, so the verifier's co-occurrence rule can tell the pairs apart. A single merged fact would let 'Acme Ltd, 2015-2018' pass unquestioned.
source: I worked at Acme Ltd from 2019 to 2021 and at Globex Corp from 2015 to 2018.

facts.text: Worked at Acme Ltd from 2019 to 2021
